title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in Wrexham, you will manage customer accounts within the Industrial / Manufacturing sector, helping the finance function keep records accurate and payments on track. You will handle day-to-day credit control work and provide clear account information that helps the business run smoothly.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Industrial & Manufacturing sector in Wrexham. They are fairly well known in the area and have a strong reputation.

Description
- Manage a portfolio of customer accounts and maintain accurate account records.
- Contact customers to follow up on outstanding payments and agree practical next steps.
- Review aged debt reports and prioritise accounts that need timely action.
- Investigate payment queries and work with relevant colleagues to resolve them.
- Keep clear notes of customer contact, payment promises and account updates.
- Issue customer statements and provide information on account balances when needed.
- Reconcile customer payments against invoices to keep records up to date.
- Share regular debt updates with the Accounting & Finance department to support informed decisions.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Experience managing customer accounts and following up overdue payments.
- Confidence reviewing account balances, invoices and payment information.
- Ability to investigate payment queries and keep account records accurate.
- Clear written and verbal communication when dealing with customers.
- Good attention to detail when recording payment activity and account updates.
- Ability to organise workload and prioritise outstanding debt effectively.

Job Offer
- Permanent Credit Controller position based in Wrexham.
- Salary of 27,000 to 33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Excellent benefits package including enhanced pension and private healthcare.
- Really accessible location with plenty of free parking on site and close to local public transport routes.
- Full time role - 37.5 hours per week.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Site Administrator
description:
Discover Tradebe

Tradebe is a group of industrial businesses with the commitment of creating a more sustainable planet and making significant contributions to human wellbeing. In the UK, we are leaders focused on recycling, energy recovery and circular economy, managing all different environmental liabilities in a sustainable way.

What will you do? Make an impact!

We're looking for a proactive and organised Site Administrator to support the day-to-day operation of our busy site. You'll be responsible for SAP administration, purchase order processing, data entry, document control, customer service and office administration, ensuring accurate records and efficient business support across the site. This role is ideal for an experienced administrator with strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What you'll be doing:

Providing administrative support to a busy waste management and operations team.
Maintaining accurate records, data entry and document control using SAP.
Processing and reconciling Hazardous Waste Consignment Notes (HWCNs) and associated documentation.
Supporting invoicing, billing administration and month-end reconciliation activities.
Managing customer service enquiries relating to collections, deliveries and invoices.
Updating customer accounts and maintaining accurate SAP records.
Coordinating compliance documentation and regulatory paperwork.
Liaising with transport, plant and operational teams to ensure accurate processing of waste management records.
Assisting with customer account setup and sales administration activities.
Producing, processing and issuing consignment notes and supporting documentation.
Promoting a positive health, safety and environmental culture and reporting any incidents or concerns.
Providing general office administration and business support to ensure the efficient running of the site.

Do you have what it takes?

Strong communication, customer service and interpersonal skills.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
Previous administration experience, including data entry and reporting.
Able to work independently and manage own workload.
Self-motivated, reliable and proactive.
Well-organised, with the ability to prioritise and multitask in a fast-paced environment.
Able to meet deadlines and handle confidential information with discretion.

We expect from you to Be accountable, Drive results, Embrace Change, and high levels of Collaboration!

What's in for you?

Salary up to £26,000 + bonus
6% Contributory Pension
A range of benefits (access to our benefits platform for discounts and cash back on shopping purchases, gyms and leisure activities, cycle to work scheme and dedicated wellbeing centre)

Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

If this offer does not match your expectations, but you would like to develop your career in a company that promotes circular economy and sustainability, register on our Career Page, and don't miss out on new job opportunities!

Tradebe is committed to guaranteeing selection processes based on merit and skills free of any bias based on age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, or nationality. We believe in equal opportunities, and we work for it.

Our store

Located in the heart of Flint, the Specsavers store is a busy and welcoming practice committed to delivering outstanding customer care and high-quality eye and hearing services to the local community. With a supportive and experienced team, the store offers a fast-paced and rewarding environment where colleagues are encouraged to develop their skills and progress their careers. Conveniently located in the town centre, the store is easily accessible by public transport, with Flint railway station and several local bus routes within walking distance, providing good links to the surrounding areas. Serving a diverse customer base, the Flint team takes pride in providing professional, personalised service, ensuring every customer receives the best possible experience from the moment they walk through the door.

What's on Offer?

As well as all the support you need and great training and development opportunities, we have a whole load of benefits on offer for you to enjoy. These include:
- Salary starting from £12.91 per hour
- Full Time - 38.75 hours per week, to include weekend working.
- We will auto-enroll you into the pension scheme with an employer contribution when you contribute too
- Specsavers Perks - a portal to a world of great everyday discounts and savings
- WeCare - our employee support service to help you and your immediate family when you need it most
- Complimentary subscription to the Headspace app
- Eyecare and hearcare discounts for you and your family
- Enjoy an additional paid day off on your birthday to celebrate you!
- Enhanced family leave and company sick pay

What we're looking for?

Some of the responsibilities of this role include:
- Coordinating patient appointments and clinic schedules.
- Delivering excellent customer service to patients and visitors.
- Managing patient enquiries in person, by phone, and via email.
- Supporting clinicians with administrative and operational tasks.
- Maintaining accurate patient records and documentation.
- Monitoring appointment availability and clinic capacity.
- Liaising with colleagues and external providers to support patient care.
- Ensuring compliance with confidentiality and health and safety standards.
- Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the clinic.
- Helping to improve the patient experience and clinic performance.

Find out more

If you've got all these skills, we'd love for you to apply, but there's also some desirable experience that could set you apart from the competition if you have it.

This includes:
- Previous experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within healthcare, optical, audiology, retail, or hospitality.
- Experience coordinating appointments, schedules, or diaries in a busy environment.
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment and prioritising multiple tasks.
- Experience in Optics or Audiology is preferred but not essential

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for a friendly, organised and reliable GP Receptionist to join our busy practice team to cover maternity leave. Welcoming patients and visitors to the practice and assisting with their enquiries. Checking patients in for their appointments and updating patient information where required. Answering incoming telephone calls promptly and dealing with patient queries. Booking, amending and cancelling appointments. Handling prescription requests and issuing or handing out prescriptions in accordance with practice procedures. We are looking for a friendly, approachable and organised GP Receptionist to join our small, busy and supportive practice team. The post holder will be responsible for providing an efficient and welcoming reception service, acting as the first point of contact for patients attending the surgery or contacting us by telephone.

title: Ward Clerk
description: THIS POST IS FIXED TERM/SECONDMENT FOR 9 MONTHS DUE TO MATERNITY COVER IF YOU ARE INTERESTED IN APPLYING FOR THE SECONDMENT POSITION, YOU MUST OBTAIN PERMISSION FROM YOUR CURRENT LINE MANAGER PRIOR TO APPLYING FOR THIS POST. For accountability and development purposes, the Ward Clerk will be under the direct responsibility of the Service Manager. title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking to recruit a full time Medical Receptionist. Monday to Friday between the hours of 08.00am - 18.30pm. A medical receptionist is the first point of contact that patients and visitors have when they go to a GP practice. They play an important part at the surgery, putting patients care as a priority. Full support is given to all staff and we have an Open Door Policy any time of the day... our Receptionist will play a vital part of a team. We are a very friendly surgery with a good range of GP's, ANP's, Nurses, HCA's. We are a teaching practice with 2 registrar's, proficient and professional reception and admin team. We offer valuable training in all aspects of reception work. Previous experience would be beneficial as a GP Practice receptionist however full training will be given. An understanding of General Practice would be advantageous. The post is subject to the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act (Exceptions Order) Have strong interpersonal and communication skills, both in person and on the telephone. Be friendly and confident. Have good organisational skills and be able to prioritise workload. Be able to cope in a busy environment, multi-tasking. Be presentable. Be flexible and adaptable. Be able to use his or her initiative. Be discreet and tactful. Be patient and sympathetic. Be courteous but firm. Be able to work well alone and in a team. Respond to Emails, Tasks from GP's Provide Appointments to Patients and deal with any queries Be able to use a computer. training will be given Strathmore is an extremely busy GP Practice with over 14 000 patients and we are looking for an enthusiastic individual to join our Reception Team. To support the Practice between the hours of 8:00 - 18:30pm. Flexibility is necessary as start times may change depending of the business needs. The Reception Team have 2 Reception Supervisors overseeing the Team and we are now recruiting for a new receptionist to join the team. Full training will be provided to the successful candidate. Serves patients by greeting and helping them, scheduling appointments, and maintaining records and accounts. Welcomes patients and visitors in person or on the telephone, and answering or referring inquiries. Comforts patients by anticipating patients anxieties, answering patients questions, and maintaining the reception area. Helps patients in distress by responding to emergencies. Protects patients rights by maintaining confidentiality of medical, personal, and financial information. Maintains operations by following policies and procedures, reporting needed changes. Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed. Flexible approach to provide cover for absent colleagues Adhere to health and safety procedures as set out by the practice Using a courteous and efficient manner at all times. Input of patients data onto the system. i.e change of address Good communication and Teamwork and work to be shared out in a fair manner Such other duties as specified by the Partners, Practice Manager, Deputy Practice Manager and Reception Supervisors
